title: Creation of the first Phyrexianized planeswalker

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: Planeswalker who became the first planeswalker to undergo compleation.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Planeswalker agent of the New Phyrexian praetors who destabilized the Emperor's spark and abducted Tamiyo.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: New Phyrexian praetor who perfected forced compleation of a planeswalker.

entities.name: The Emperor
entities.description: Planeswalker ruler of Kamigawa whose spark Tezzeret destabilized.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: Planeswalker who with Tamiyo tried to dismantle the research facilities.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Plane where the Reality Chip was used.

entities.name: Reality Chip
entities.description: Prototype device used to destabilize the Emperor's spark.

entities.name: Planar Bridge
entities.description: Tezzeret's device used to move between planes.

entities.name: Compleation
entities.description: Phyrexian process of converting a planeswalker.

entities.name: Light-Paws
entities.description: Appointed Regent of Kamigawa by the Emperor.

entities.name: Asari Uprisers
entities.description: Rebels whose rebellion the Emperor ended.

events.summary: Tezzeret infiltrates Kamigawa and destabilizes the Emperor's spark with the prototype Reality Chip.
events.quote: deploying the prototype Reality Chip to destabilize her spark

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias arrives through the Planar Bridge; he and Tezzeret ambush Kaito and Tamiyo.
events.quote: they were ambushed by both Jin-Gitaxias and Tezzeret

events.summary: The Emperor planewalks in and slices through Jin-Gitaxias.
Tezzeret regains the Reality Chip, overrides Tamiyo's will and takes her to New Phyrexia.
Tamiyo is compleated under Jin-Gitaxias's supervision, the first planeswalker to be so converted.
events.quote: Tamiyo became the first planeswalker to undergo the process of Compleation

events.summary: The Emperor ends the Asari Uprisers' rebellion with Kaito and appoints Light-Paws as Regent before being ripped away.
events.quote: she appointed Light-Paws as Regent of the plane

events.summary: Kaito swears to find the Emperor and Tamiyo and take revenge on Tezzeret.
events.quote: Kaito swore to track down both the Emperor and Tamiyo

relations.note: Agent of the New Phyrexian praetors
relations.quote: under the orders of the New Phyrexian praetors

relations.note: Worked together to protect the Emperor
relations.quote: Kaito Shizuki and Tamiyo moved to dismantle
